frontier_act_119.text: AI is advancing rapidly, and Congress has an important role to play in addressing the most serious risks without undermining American innovation. I recently joined Elex Michaelson on CNN’s “The Story Is” to discuss my bipartisan FRONTIER Act and how we can establish clear, risk-based guardrails for the most advanced AI systems while keeping the United States at the forefront of AI development.

frontier_act_119.text:
The creation of the new White House task force on advanced AI is an important step toward ensuring America remains the global leader in this transformative technology while addressing the risks posed by the most advanced systems. Our bipartisan House Task Force on Artificial Intelligence made clear that getting this balance right requires a risk-based approach that addresses serious threats without stifling American innovation. That same principle is at the heart of my bipartisan FRONTIER Act, and I look forward to working with the Administration as it develops its recommendations.
https://t.co/jb8AO4gv9i

I recently joined CBS Los Angeles to discuss how my bipartisan FRONTIER Act would establish guardrails for the most advanced AI models without stifling American innovation.

I joined NewsNation Live to discuss how my bipartisan FRONTIER Act would establish appropriate oversight and safeguards for the most advanced AI systems while ensuring the United States continues to lead the world in AI. As this technology develops, Congress needs to focus on clear, identifiable risks and put in place a framework that protects Americans without undermining our ability to innovate.

My bipartisan National Commission on Robotics Act will help ensure America stays competitive and turn innovation into real world results for our workforce and economy.

I highlighted the need for Congress to do its job by putting a clear federal framework in place for AI so the United States can remain safe, competitive, support innovation, and address national security risks as this technology continues to advance.

ai_action_plan_2025.text: I also wanted to, in addition to commending you for the good work of CAISI, talk about the need for us in Congress to formally codify it. And, you know, the work it does in doing AI model evaluation is essential in creating what's a—what's a toolbox, a regulatory toolbox, for our sectoral regulators so everyone doesn't have to reinvent the wheel. But, you know, we've had this in successive Administrations now. Under the Biden Administration, we had the AI Safety Institute. The Trump Administration, we have CAISI. There are many of the same functions that are performed by those organizations. But I think everyone would agree it's unhealthy for us to have every successive Administration spin up a brand new agency that essentially is doing something with a long-term mission that needs continuity.

Today I introduced the bipartisan FRONTIER Act with @RepLoriTrahan to establish clear national rules of the road for the largest AI developers, including transparency, independent evaluations and reporting of serious incidents. This legislation builds on our Great American AI Act framework to protect Americans from catastrophic risks and ensure the United States remains the global leader in AI. https://t.co/OOMlIDKAxc

great_american_ai_2026.text: At an Energy and Commerce hearing on global competitiveness, I discussed how America can lead in the technologies that will shape the future of our economy, manufacturing base, and national security. That includes advancing a national robotics strategy through my National Commission on Robotics Act and creating a clear federal framework for advanced AI through the Great American AI Act. These technologies are moving rapidly, and Congress has a responsibility to act equally quickly in responding to them.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says he is creating a clear federal framework for advanced AI through the Great American AI Act.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The named framework is explicitly endorsed as his legislative vehicle.

great_american_ai_2026.text: As AI systems become more complex and widely used, policymakers, researchers, and the public need clearer information about how these models are developed, trained, and deployed. The READ AI Models Act is a key piece of my Great American AI Act and will help create a flexible framework for documenting AI models and their data. This bipartisan bill will strengthen transparency, improve risk management, and give federal agencies better tools to oversee AI while encouraging continued innovation. I’m proud that the Science, Space, and Technology Committee advanced this important legislation.

deepseek.reason: The speaker calls the READ AI Models Act a key piece of his Great American AI Act and praises the committee advancing this important legislation.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly names and endorses the Great American AI Act framework.

great_american_ai_2026.text: Preparing students for an AI-empowered economy must be a national priority. The NSF AI Education Act, an important piece of my Great American AI Act, will expand scholarships, fellowships, and professional development opportunities to help students, teachers, and workers build skills in artificial intelligence. As AI continues to transform the workplace, this bipartisan bill helps ensure the next generation of Americans is ready to lead. I was proud to see it pass the Science, Space, and Technology Committee.

deepseek.reason: The speaker calls the NSF AI Education Act an important piece of his Great American AI Act and praises its committee advancement.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly names and endorses the Great American AI Act framework.

great_american_ai_2026.text: The Science, Space, and Technology Committee also advanced my CREATE AI Act, another key piece of my Great American AI Act. This bipartisan bill will establish the National Artificial Intelligence Research Resource to give American researchers, students, educators, and small businesses access to the compute, data, models, and tools they need to develop advanced AI. America’s AI future cannot be limited to only the largest companies. To stay competitive, we need our universities, entrepreneurs, and next generation of innovators leading the way.

deepseek.reason: The speaker calls the CREATE AI Act another key piece of his Great American AI Act and praises its advancement.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly names and endorses the Great American AI Act framework.

great_american_ai_2026.text: Last week the Science, Space, and Technology Committee advanced my AI Security and Innovation Act, which is part of my broader Great American AI Act. AI is the foundational technology of our time, and Congress must ensure the federal government has the technical expertise and evaluation capabilities needed to address emerging risks while keeping America at the forefront of innovation. This bipartisan bill establishes the Center for AI Security and Innovation within the federal government and takes an important step toward the AI governance framework recommended by the bipartisan House AI Task Force.

deepseek.reason: The speaker calls the Great American AI Act his broader framework and describes advancing a component of it.
deepseek.confidence_reason: He explicitly claims ownership of the named framework.
